# Feedback

**Status:** Trial  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the Feedback component to give users a consistent, low-distraction route for sharing their experience of a service.

## When to use

- Use on as many service pages as practical when the team has a feedback route it monitors.
- Place immediately before the footer so it remains available without distracting from the current task.

## When not to use

- Do not use when feedback is not reviewed or cannot influence the service.
- Do not use it as a replacement for a support route when users need help completing a task.

## Anatomy

- **Feedback region (required):** A govuk-feedback container uses the standard width and grid.
- **Title (required):** A configurable heading identifies the invitation.
- **Message and link (required):** Brief body copy explains why feedback is useful and links to the feedback route.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `div` | `govuk-feedback`, `govuk-width-container` | The service-wide invitation shown before the footer. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- The component has no GOV.UK JavaScript behaviour; its link must work without JavaScript.
- In the Nunjucks page template, place it in footerStart so document order remains consistent.
- Treat this Trial component as changeable and review it on every GOV.UK Frontend update.

## Accessibility contract

- Set headingLevel so the title fits the page's heading hierarchy.
- Make the feedback link purpose clear from its text and surrounding sentence.
- Distinguish feedback from urgent help and provide an accessible support route elsewhere.

## Content rules

- Explain why feedback is requested and what the team will do with it.
- Where useful, say how long providing feedback will take and distinguish it from support.
- Use a direct label such as “Give us your feedback”.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.surface-background`
- `govuk.color.text`
- `govuk.color.link`
- `govuk.layout.page-width`

## HTML examples

### Service feedback invitation

```html
<div class="govuk-feedback govuk-width-container">
  <div class="govuk-grid-row">
    <div class="govuk-grid-column-two-thirds">
      <h2 class="govuk-feedback__title">Help us improve this service</h2>
      <div class="govuk-feedback__body">
        <p class="govuk-body">Tell us about your experience using this service. <a href="/feedback" class="govuk-link">Give us your feedback</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
